caption: The drawing depicts a closed book with a brown cover. The title "Mother Goose" is written in uppercase letters in the center of the cover in a slightly darker brown color. The book cover features bands of floral designs at the top and bottom; these bands contain illustrated flowers and leaves, all in the same brown color as the cover, with the flower details slightly outlined for contrast. Along the left side of the book, there are three brown ties that close the book, with the loose ends hanging to the left. A faint green shadow is visible to the right and bottom of the book, cast onto a pale beige or off-white background. The spine of the book is visible on the right edge, and a hint of the book’s pages can be seen next to the spine. The composition is centered with the book taking up most of the space.
title: Leather Book Cover
